description: Pakistan - Energy Access: Household Panel Survey Data is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Energy access, Surveys", published or maintained by Lisanne Heemskerk (World Bank Group). This research activity was carried out by Enclude for approximately 8,500 household survey across Pakistan to measure the energy access rates, consumption patterns and economic & psychographic drivers to ‘energy relevant’ behaviours. Coverage: Pakistan. It has 3 files in CSV, XLS. The portal files it under Energy access, Surveys. The portal gives 2016 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
